entries.en: A fictional, local-only recovery desk that sends nothing anywhere and cannot delete storage for you.
entries.yue: 呢個係虛構、只在本機運作嘅復原服務台，唔會將任何資料傳出去，亦唔可以代你刪除儲存資料。

entries.en: Applies color roles, contrast, surfaces, and status layers.
entries.yue: 套用色彩角色、對比、表面同狀態層。

entries.en: Both speaks English first and Cantonese second, without overlap.
entries.yue: 兩者模式會先讀英文，再讀廣東話，絕不重疊。
瀏覽器本機 TOTP 驗證器

entries.en: Browsers cannot reliably detect a running screen reader. Turn this on when assistive speech is active and the narrator will cancel and remain quiet.
entries.yue: 瀏覽器無法可靠偵測正在運作嘅螢幕閱讀器。輔助語音啟用時請開啟呢項，旁白就會取消並保持安靜。

entries.en: Changes spacing and target presentation while preserving minimum interactive sizes.
entries.yue: 調整間距同目標呈現，同時保留最小互動尺寸。

entries.en: Changes the website label only. Package identity, data keys, downloads, and diagnostics keep the shipped name.
entries.yue: 只會改網站顯示名稱。套件識別、資料鍵、下載同診斷仍會保留原本名稱。

entries.en: Choose a shipped preset or a bounded local image. Custom bytes remain in this browser and never change package identity.
entries.yue: 揀隨附預設或者有界限嘅本機圖片。自訂位元組只留喺呢個瀏覽器，絕對唔會改套件識別。

entries.en: Choose any color or the animated rainbow sentinel. Reduced motion settles the rainbow on one hue.
entries.yue: 任揀顏色或者動畫彩虹哨兵值。減少動效時，彩虹會定格喺一種色調。

entries.en: Choose automatically. Waiting for browser voice enumeration.
entries.yue: 自動選擇。等緊瀏覽器列出可用聲音。

entries.en: Choose English, playful Hong Kong-style Cantonese, or compact bilingual presentation.
entries.yue: 選擇英文、玩味香港廣東話，或者精簡雙語顯示。
關閉正則表達式工作台
關閉標題包含文字嘅分頁
關閉標題唔包含文字嘅分頁
編譯內建預設：生長髮絲
編譯內建預設：Hair Growth Estimator
編譯內建預設：系統無襯線字體

entries.en: De-emphasizes inactive sections without hiding them.
entries.yue: 淡化非使用中區段，但唔會將佢哋收埋。

entries.en: Decorative emoji never changes an action label or accessible name.
entries.yue: 裝飾 emoji 唔會改動操作標籤或者無障礙名稱。

entries.en: Dock left, right, top, or bottom. Left is the default.
entries.yue: 可停靠左、右、上或者下。預設係左邊。

entries.en: Each category preserves the same factual placeholders in both languages at every funny level.
entries.yue: 每個類別喺每個玩味程度下，兩種語言都會保留完全相同嘅事實預留位置。

entries.en: Enter text to preview affected tabs.
entries.yue: 輸入文字，預覽會受影響嘅分頁。

entries.en: Key one: I reviewed the affected data
entries.yue: 第一把鑰匙：我已檢視受影響資料

entries.en: Key two: I understand this cannot be undone here
entries.yue: 第二把鑰匙：我明白呢度無法復原

entries.en: Level 1 is fully serious. Level 5 is most playful. Facts remain unchanged.
entries.yue: 程度 1 完全認真，程度 5 最玩味。事實保持不變。
未有啟用任何本機快取。

entries.en: Nothing is sent anywhere. No ticket exists outside this browser, no network request is made, no data is collected, and nobody is reading it.
entries.yue: 任何資料都唔會傳送出去。支援單唔會離開呢個瀏覽器，唔會發出網絡請求，唔會收集資料，亦冇人會閱讀。

entries.en: Off by default. Events are serialized and yield when the visitor reports active assistive technology.
entries.yue: 預設關閉。事件會依序處理，訪客表示輔助技術正在使用時會讓行。

entries.en: Offers a factual, dismissible prompt after inactivity. It does not score or judge.
entries.yue: 閒置一段時間後提供可關閉嘅事實提示。唔會評分，亦唔會批判。

entries.en: One global level controls all animated rainbow surfaces.
entries.yue: 一個全域程度控制所有動畫彩虹表面。

entries.en: Open regex builder for narrated language

entries.en: Open regex builder for overflow tab search
entries.yue: 開啟溢出分頁搜尋嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Open regex builder for palette size
entries.yue: 開啟面板大小嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Open regex builder for scheduled density
entries.yue: 開啟排程密度嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Open regex builder for scheduled language
entries.yue: 開啟排程語言嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Open regex builder for scheduled theme
entries.yue: 開啟排程主題嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Open regex builder for settings search
entries.yue: 開啟設定搜尋嘅正則表達式建構器
開啟主題嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Open regex builder for ticket category
entries.yue: 開啟支援單類別嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Open regex builder for ticket search
entries.yue: 開啟支援單搜尋嘅正則表達式建構器

entries.en: Original wording remains active until a complete bounded file validates. No mapping is bundled.
entries.yue: 完整且有界限嘅檔案通過驗證前，會繼續使用原本文字。冇隨附任何對照。
otpauth URI 或 Base32 密鑰
密碼加 PIN 加 TOTP

entries.en: QR image decoding and camera access are visible but unavailable in this static build because no verified local decoder is bundled.
entries.yue: QR 圖片解碼同相機存取會顯示，但喺呢個靜態版本中無法使用，因為未有隨附經驗證嘅本機解碼器。

entries.en: Reduces non-essential motion, contrast shifts, and informational interruptions.
entries.yue: 減少非必要動效、對比變化同資訊干擾。

entries.en: Resolution: open browser settings, find site data for this address, and delete it yourself. This static website cannot open an application-data folder or delete browser storage outside its own clear-data control.
entries.yue: 解決方法：開啟瀏覽器設定，搵到呢個網址嘅網站資料，再自行刪除。呢個靜態網站無法開啟應用程式資料夾，亦無法喺本身嘅清除資料控制以外刪除瀏覽器儲存資料。

entries.en: Review the exact affected data before continuing.
entries.yue: 繼續之前，請檢視確實會受影響嘅資料。

entries.en: Rules use the displayed browser timezone. Higher priority wins, then the later rule in the list. Equal start and end means all day, and cross-midnight windows continue into the next day.
entries.yue: 規則使用畫面顯示嘅瀏覽器時區。優先次序較高者勝出，其次係清單中較後嘅規則。開始同結束時間相同代表全日，跨午夜時段會延續到翌日。
搜尋所有目的地同控制項
只限工作階段嘅存取 token

entries.en: Settings apply to this website only and persist in local browser storage.
entries.yue: 設定只套用於呢個網站，並保存在本機瀏覽器儲存空間。

entries.en: Settings, haircut planning, locks, tickets, notifications, and history stay in a revisioned localStorage envelope. Same-origin tabs use Web Locks or an IndexedDB transaction to serialize writes, reconcile storage events, and visibly refuse stale changes. This is convenience storage, not a security boundary.
entries.yue: 設定、理髮規劃、鎖定、支援單、通知同歷史記錄會留喺經修訂版本管理嘅 localStorage 封套。相同來源分頁會用 Web Locks 或 IndexedDB transaction 串行化寫入、協調 storage events，並清楚拒絕過時變更。呢啲只係便利儲存，唔係安全邊界。
共用瀏覽器顯示已關閉。

entries.en: Show emojis in dialogs and message boxes
entries.yue: 喺對話框同訊息方塊顯示 emoji

entries.en: Shows session elapsed time and time since the last browser-local change.
entries.yue: 顯示工作階段經過時間，同埋距離上次瀏覽器本機變更嘅時間。

entries.en: Stores one user-chosen next action across reloads.
entries.yue: 跨重新載入保存一個由使用者揀選嘅下一步操作。

entries.en: The operating-system preference always wins. This switch can request even less motion.
entries.yue: 作業系統偏好設定永遠優先。呢個開關可以要求更少動效。

entries.en: The token stays only in this tab's memory and is never written to browser storage, history, exports, logs, or documentation. Reloading requires it again.
entries.yue: 呢個 token 只會留喺目前分頁嘅記憶體，絕不寫入瀏覽器儲存、歷史、匯出、記錄或者文件。重新載入後需要再提供。

entries.en: This is a self-imposed speed bump, not security or encryption. Clear this website's local storage to reset every lock.
entries.yue: 呢個只係自己加嘅小阻力，唔係安全或者加密。清除呢個網站嘅本機儲存即可重設所有鎖。

entries.en: This lock clears access to the element only. It does not sign in, create an account session, or protect data from someone with browser access.
entries.yue: 呢個鎖只會恢復使用該元素，唔會登入、建立帳戶工作階段，亦唔會防止可以存取瀏覽器嘅人睇到資料。

entries.en: This website uses localStorage rather than an operating-system credential vault. That is not suitable for valuable account secrets. Prefer a dedicated authenticator. Clearing this site's storage removes entries.
entries.yue: 呢個網站使用 localStorage，而唔係作業系統憑證保管庫。唔適合儲存重要帳戶密鑰，請優先使用專用驗證器。清除呢個網站嘅儲存資料會移除項目。

entries.en: Unavailable: no bundled QR decoder has packaged-artifact proof.
entries.yue: 無法使用：冇隨附具套件成品證據嘅 QR 解碼器。

entries.en: Uses a local system font with a CJK-safe fallback and live preview.
entries.yue: 使用本機系統字體、CJK 安全後備字體同即時預覽。

entries.en: Uses one same-origin browser record, forces English, and removes Cantonese, funny-level, vocabulary, and dim-sum capabilities until turned off.
entries.yue: 使用一個相同來源瀏覽器記錄，強制英文，並喺關閉之前移除廣東話、玩味程度、詞彙同點心功能。

entries.en: Uses the browser's documented speech synthesis ranges.
entries.yue: 使用瀏覽器文件記載嘅語音合成範圍。
